name: SynTReN
simulation_summary: Generates synthetic transcriptional regulatory networks and bulk microarray-like RNA expression datasets from known source-network topology, nonlinear regulatory functions, external-condition inputs and configurable biological/experimental noise.

conditional_required.usage: Wrapper passes this SIF file to SynTReN as NetworkSIFFile when source_network.preset=custom_sif.
Wrapper passes this table to SynTReN as externalsFile when external_inputs.fixed_source=custom_table.

compatibility_rules.message: external_inputs.num_correlated_externals must be smaller than num_externals when num_externals is non-negative.

threading.upstream_mapping: SynTReN 1.2 is executed through the public Java CLI/API. The reviewed ini settings, CLI documentation and release notes expose no thread, worker, OpenMP, BLAS or process-count control, so ANDREA must run the wrapper with runtime_resources.threads=1.

source_network.description: Source topology consumed by SynTReN as NetworkSIFFile.

preset.description: Selects a bundled SynTReN source SIF file or a user-provided syntren_source_network_sif input. The executable container vendors the verified local SynTReN 1.2 release because the archived official 1.2 ZIP is no longer retrievable.

subnetwork.description: Controls SynTReN subnetwork selection from the source SIF. Perturbational predefined-external runs lock enabled=false because fixedExternals is only supported on complete source networks.

num_nodes.description: Maps to nrNodes, the number of foreground nodes selected when subnetwork.enabled=true.

num_background_nodes.description: Maps to nrBackgroundNodes, the number of background nodes selected when subnetwork.enabled=true.

interactions.description: Controls assignment of SynTReN regulatory interaction categories and nonlinear transfer-function families. The exported public truth is topological because SynTReN's public SIF export writes generated edges with token un.

use_edge_types_from_sif.description: Maps to useEdgeTypesFromSIF. ac/re SIF tokens affect upstream interaction generation, but the public generated SIF exported by SynTReN 1.2 writes topological edges as un.

percent_activators.description: Maps to percentActivators, the desired fraction of activating interactions in SynTReN's internal transfer-function assignment.

higher_order_probability.description: Maps to higherOrderProbability for synergistic or antagonistic two-input interactions.

external_inputs.description: Controls SynTReN external input values. The selected semantic capability locks mode so users cannot change the experimental design chosen in the scenario.

mode.description: Scenario-controlled mapping to externalInputValues=RANDOMIZED, FROM_EXTERNALS_FILE or FIXED.

fixed_source.description: Selects the predefined externalsFile used when mode=from_file. custom_table requires the syntren_externals_table simulator input.

num_externals.description: Maps to nrExternals. -1 means all top nodes are external nodes.

num_correlated_externals.description: Maps to nrCorrelatedExternals. -1 means SynTReN uses half independent and half correlated external nodes.

correlation_noise.description: Maps to correlationNoise for correlated external inputs.

sampling.description: Controls simulated expression sampling from the generated network.

noise.description: SynTReN biological, input and microarray experimental noise levels.

expression_variant.description: Selects which SynTReN expression dataset is normalized into expression.tsv. The v1.2 documentation recommends the unnormalized dataset; max_expr_1 preserves the old 0..1 output range.

truth_contexts.generation: The wrapper exports the generated GeneNetwork XML to SIF through SynTReN's public GeneNetwork API and emits one truth/networks.csv row per non-self regulator-target edge with context=global and evidence=simulated_truth.
truth_contexts.score_semantics: score is 1.0 because SynTReN exposes simulated topology but not a public edge-confidence score; sign is '?' because the verified generated SIF export uses token un for generated edges.
limitations: SynTReN uses one fixed regulatory network for every expression column in the run.
Internal transfer-function signs affect expression generation but are not preserved in a stable public signed edge artifact by the verified API route.

truth_contexts.explanation: SynTReN does not define column groups with distinct regulatory networks; random external-condition samples all share the same generated TRN.
SynTReN does not emit sample-specific regulatory rewiring; every expression column is simulated from the same generated TRN.

parameter_bindings.description: Bulk observational runs use randomized external conditions rather than a predefined perturbation table.

derivations.method: Write every normalized expression gene identifier to extras/enrichment_background.txt, one gene per line.
assumptions: The simulated expression row universe is the appropriate synthetic background for downstream enrichment workflows.
limitations: No organism-specific functional annotation universe is simulated.

derivations.method: Write the same non-self topological edges used for global truth into extras/prior_grn.tsv with source, target and score.
assumptions: The simulator truth may be useful as an oracle prior only when explicitly requested.
limitations: This is truth-derived, not an independent noisy prior.

derivations.method: Write unique source genes from non-self global truth edges to extras/tf_list.txt, one gene per line.
assumptions: Genes with outgoing simulated regulatory edges define the synthetic regulator universe.
limitations: The list is simulator-derived and not an organism-specific TF catalogue.

native_outputs.description: Native SynTReN normalized dataset artifact, including *_maxExpr1_dataset.txt naming when emitted by a SynTReN release.
Resolved external input table consumed by SynTReN for the run, preserved as a native-facing output when requested.
Resolved SynTReN ini configuration executed by the wrapper.

artifacts_aux.description: Wrapper-generated ini file with absolute /work paths and resolved scenario-controlled bindings.

limitations: Predefined external conditions perturb inputs but do not rewire the generated TRN.
The public GRN therefore remains global for all perturbation columns.

truth_contexts.explanation: SynTReN predefined external-input experiments do not produce group-specific regulatory networks.
Each perturbation column changes external input values but is simulated from the same generated TRN; SynTReN does not emit perturbation-specific GRN rewiring.

parameter_bindings.description: Bulk perturbational runs use predefined external input values from an externalsFile.
SynTReN fixedExternals=true is documented as only possible when selectSubnetwork=false.

derivations.method: Treat each externalsFile experiment column as one public perturbation column, record the external regulators with values different from the column baseline, and align rows to normalized expression column identifiers.
assumptions: The predefined external-input columns are the intended perturbation/condition labels.
The wrapper uses the same externalsFile that SynTReN consumed for the expression run.
limitations: SynTReN external values are continuous expression inputs, not explicit knockout/overexpression operators.
Intervention effect magnitudes are comparable within the selected externalsFile but not necessarily across independently designed externals files.

derivations.method: Collapse distinct external-input vectors from perturbation_design into extras/interventions.tsv, preserving regulator IDs, signed direction relative to baseline and numeric values when available.
assumptions: Columns with identical external-input vectors represent the same intervention class.
limitations: The direction is defined relative to a wrapper-documented baseline, not an upstream causal operator label.
